sources.title: Llama Nemoretriever Colembed: Top-Performing Text-Image Retrieval Model
sources.snippet: Motivated by the growing demand for retrieval systems that operate across modalities, we introduce llama-nemoretriever-colembed, a unified text-image retrieval model that delivers state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks. We release two model variants, 1B and 3B.

sources.title: CoLLM: A Large Language Model for Composed Image Retrieval
sources.snippet: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) is a complex task that aims to retrieve images based on a multimodal query. Typical training data consists of triplets containing a reference image, a textual description of desired modifications, and the target image, which are expensive and time-consuming to acquire.
